summary: The letter from United Data Technologies and Tennessee school leaders urges the FCC not to cut E‑Rate support for schools classified as urban, arguing that many such areas contain rural, economically disadvantaged communities. They also emphasize the need to keep Category Two services (internal connections and equipment) funded to maintain reliable, secure connectivity for instruction and safety.
